book.name: Romans
book.title: ROMANS PAUL AN FEF IGAYAM ROME YANGAN AURIS

content: God An Kaber Israel Yangan auris
Yau abitetemim: God min Toun an sabu ebisisiweiis i? Ambin bag! Yau tou on Israel orot, Abraham an dam warar emon, yau Benjamin an dam warar an orot tani.
God an sabu ato anai bag irurubines on men isisiweiis on. Omi dura bag wosagob dura mamaba buk amonai Elijah aurin sigagayam on, on mamaba God aurin ibayoi Israel yangan ibiragites aurin on.

Elijah ibayoi iyau, “Bada osi on Om am aubairuruotis engon tutufin siyasububunues isawar a am sirifu kema on engon sigorosen sisawar, ato yau aubairuruotiu ekesiu mom wat on amama, ato osi sefofourtobon yau sinasubunueu mes.”
Ato God on abi dura on Elijah iyafotai? On iyau, “Yau Tou au sabu on 7,000 on abotanis, osi on men baisigogo god wabin Baal on sikwafirai on.”
On eta kaitamomai ari an werai min on nanaba: Yabin God an kaberai on sabu ruamom on irubines.

On an rubin ibiyamai on an kaberai on nan itawar iyamai, men osi bobo aifan sifofour nan iyamai on. Ato God an rubin on ato sabu bobo aifan sefofour on nan ittatawar on, On an kaber on men maiauin bag on.

On mes bobo min on nanaba imatar: Israel sabu aifan sinunuen on men sigaturai on. Sabu ruamom on ato God irurubines on sigaturai; sabu fani on God iyoyores on tainas ifot men fofonin dura sittatam on.
God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, “God on sabu ifouris nunuas a asi not ituf; ari wera inat i’gat min on eb osi men fofonin tous matasi sinitai o tainasi dura sintatam on.”
Ato David iyau,

content.text: “Yau God aurin ababayoi on asi bobaitab amonai nan on inboes ato inkonatis sinafeu; yau ababayoi osi on sinafeu ato inimakies!
Yau ababayoi osi matas sinyafofoten onai osi matas on men fofonin sineit; a iniyames baikokosar sinboai asi bit ra fufur si’nabar kous nana sinkwakwatut.”

content: Yau abitetem: Jew yangan ass sirugedanen on sifeu sikomas isawar i? Ambin bag! Yabin osi sibokomas, on mes yawas on inat sabu men Jew yangan auris igat, itiyames Jew yangan on osi auris sitiboboar mes.

Jew yangan sibokomas on mes, baimomogin gagamin on inat au tafanam ato osi Ayu an yawasai on sikokoianis on mes baimomogin on inat sabu men Jew yangan auris. On mes Jew yangan kuayo gagamin sinnat God an gogoi nanaba sinbikaita on, baimomogin gagamin bag on arimon innat!
Sabu Men Jew Yangan on Siyawas
Yau ari dura on omi sabu men Jew yangan aurim abikakafun: Yau on omi sabu men Jew yangan ami baiyoyobotiu amama on, yau tou au bobo aurin on abogagaiai.
Tait yau arimon aniyamai tou au sabu on siniboboar, on bobo nanaba anafour ato asi not anikitabiren ato God arimon sabu fani iniyawasis.

Yabin God osi sabu Jew yangan ibisisiweiis on, tafanamai sabu on God mat situran. God ato osi Jew sabu itibasites itboboes mes on dura bag osi on arimon ato osi sabu ba serarabob ato seyayawas men, on nanaba sitmatar!
Rafi turin ainauin God sitbibitai on, ato rafi tutufin mat min God noan; a wengar aweroron God aurin sinkutetai on, ato wengar fafames mat min On ebinoanai.

Olive wengar fani ato ass setarereben on God fafames iturutoben ato olive wengar ato tous sikubobouis sigegeg on wengar ann kaitamomai nan itutufeyen. Omi sabu men Jew yangan on olive wengar ato tous sikubobouis sigeg ba, ato ari on omi faiwar a yawas gagamin Jew yangan ainau si’boai on wobo.
Sabu ato wengar fafames ba siturutoben auris on omi men toum wonbogaiim mes. On mes omi on men wontaseseir mes. Omi on wengar fafamen ba; omi on men aweroron wobotan on—aweroron on omi ebotanim.
Baise omi arimon wonau, “Dura bag, baise wengar fafames on siturutoben onai yau on wengar fafamesi on nan au efan atboai atitufeyeu mes.”

Atonio on dura bag. Osi on siturutoben yabin osi on men situtum on mes, baise omi on nana efan kaita womama yabin omi on woitutum on mes. Baise omi on men on bobo aurin on taseseirai nan woninonot mes; baise omi on wonaber.
Jew sabu on wengar fafames maiauis, baise God on men ikirires efan kaitamom sima on, ato omi men wonbitutum on On men arimon inikirirem nana wonama on.

Atonio nin on tanitai tansagob mamaba God on emamanau a mamaba dura wawaninai nan sabu ebigurubabanis on. Sabu iyabon si’bokomas on dura wawaninai nan ebigurubabanis, baise omi aurim on mamanauin—omi nana On an manau kaber an yawasai wonmama on; baise omi men on yawasai wonmama on, omi mat God arimon inturutobim.
Ato Jew yangan God sinbitutumai men on, arimon inboes men asi efan menan simama on nan inyeinis men, yabin God on fofonin arimon inboes inyeinis men.

Omi sabu men Jew yangan on ato olive wengar ba, tous sikubouis segeg ato fafames on God iturutoben ba, ato wonat olive wengar obis ato ass setarereben on mat woitufe. Jew yangan on atonio wengar ass setarereben ba; ato God aurin on sasasan wat arimon atonio wengar fafames iturutoben on inboen an wengarai bag initufeyen men.
God An Kaber Sabu Engon auris

Yau taitaiu tutuau, yau agogoi ato dura maiauin buburin on wonsagob. Atonio dura maiauin wonsasagob on, men arimon toum wonnosim wonau, omi on gigiboanotim. Dura maiauin min atonio: Israel sabu turin wat on nunuas siyamen sibiwawanien on men wantoan inen on, ab on arimon nana i’nen weie sabu men Jew yangan engon tutufin on sinnat God aurin.
Atonio bobo nanaba on Israel yangan engon sinyawas. God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau,

content.text: “Baiyawasotin on arimon Zion emon innat, ato Jacob an dam warar emon on bobo komasis engon on inboen inan.
Yau arimon atonio dura bobaibasit on mat aniyamai, on an ra asi bokomas anboen annanan on.”

content: Yabin Jew yangan on Wasagobin sisisiweiai on mes, osi sinat God an ragit simatar, omi sabu men Jew yangan fasimui on mes atonio bobo min imatar. Baise yabin God on osi sabu irubinis on mes, osi on On tuturan, yabin God on osi wawas agiris gagamis auris iyaumatan on mes.
Yabin God on men an not ebikitabirai on iyafan irubinai a ebimomoginai on.
Ato omi sabu men Jew yangan aurim on, omi ainau on God aurin woifonaseir; baise ari on omi God an kaber wobo yabin Jew yangan sifonaseir on mes.
On eta kaitamomai, Jew yangan on ari God aurin sifonaseir, yabin omi kaber wobo on mes onai osi mat ari on God an kaber sinboai.
Yabin sabu engon tutufin on God fonan siseseir on mes On ifouris fafatum amonai ba simama, On atonio bobo ifour onai On an kaber on osi sabu engon auris itiyoboes mes.
God Tanifain
God an obin on gagamin bag! God an gigiboan a an sagob on gagamin bag! God an bainonot ebiyamen on iyafan arimon inau bubunagen tiwag? Iyafan arimon On an eta on insagob?
God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau,

content.text: “Iyafan on Bada an not isagob? Iyafan on arimon giu dura initai?
Iyafan wat on siwar tani ibo itai, onai On siwar igaraminai men?”

content: Yabin sawar engon on On ifouren, ato sawar engon on On emon simatar a sawar engon on On aurin wat. God tanifain taniduduranai au wantoan au wantoan! Dura bag.
